source_text: Such views hold that while Jewish status derives matrilineally regardless of circumcision, forgoing the procedure constitutes deliberate disobedience to Torah law, potentially weakening communal adherence to mitzvot and echoing historical assaults on Jewish practice, such as Roman bans on circumcision aimed at eradicating the faith.
